clips.caption:
Most people spend nearly all their time chasing the how.

Kevin Trudeau points to the stack of courses people buy — how to trade crypto, how to flip real estate with no money down, how to build a business online. Good programs. Programs that actually work.

And still, 99% of the people who take them never get the results they paid for.

Not because the course failed them. Because they skipped the one step that comes before any course matters: deciding exactly what they want.

Which one have you been missing — the technique, or the target?
